entry.title: Stoddard Select board / council: Housing development (2026-10-14)
entry.summary: ...: A permit for a 45-foot long, 12-inch-wide wall was approved. The project meets all setbacks, is not near wetlands.  State Law Changes (ADUs): An email update from the state clarified new rules for [Accessory Dwelling Units] (ADUs). The definition of "attached" was updated, and pre- 2005 nonconforming structures can now be converted to ADUs by right. Additionally, ADU-related permits can extend beyond one year.  Activit...
